subject: Fix flaky save/restore test (#495)
reason: The change is a test fix plus diagnostics: the integration test gains a wait for index backfill after restart (test code only), log.cc loses a blank line, and module OnLoad gains a read-only loop over /proc/self/maps that logs each loaded .so's base address at NOTICE level to make addr2line work on crash dumps. No command, reply, indexing, persistence or replication behaviour changes; the new code runs once at module load, reads procfs with bounds-checked parsing, and only emits log lines, which no fuzzer oracle observes beyond module load succeeding — something every run already exercises.
